name: Bakugan Dragonoid

specialAbility.name: Dragon Fire
specialAbility.description: Bakugan Dragonoid spreads its wings and blasts a scorching fireball straight at the enemy truck!

lore: When a legendary Bakugan card landed on a monster truck rally, the truck it touched transformed into a fire-breathing dragon on wheels! Bakugan Dragonoid has real dragon wings on its sides, glowing orange scales, and can shoot fireballs from its hood. It rolls into battle like a boss!
